subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should this issue remain the canonical cross-runtime yielded-parent wake contract, with narrow PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95776 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080 landing as slices, or should maintainers require one explicit yield-wait lifecycle design first?
rationale: The expected behavior is a real bug contract, but the remaining fix shape spans ACP relay, task terminal delivery, native subagent announce delivery, heartbeat-disabled operation, and session-state semantics.

options.title: Land Narrow Slices, Keep Canonical Open
options.body: Review and land well-proven ACP/native slices while this issue remains open until cross-runtime yielded-parent wake coverage is complete.

options.title: Require One Yield-Wait Design
options.body: Pause narrow slices until maintainers define a single persisted yield-wait lifecycle and event contract for ACP and native child completions.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move each failure mode to a narrower issue and keep this issue only as an umbrella reference, but do not close it until all duplicates are safely linked.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Slices, Keep Canonical Open
recommendation.body: Review and land well-proven ACP/native slices while this issue remains open until cross-runtime yielded-parent wake coverage is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans heartbeat, ACP, subagent lifecycle, and session-state owner boundaries where recent history points to steipete as a broad adjacent contributor.
